name: Zond-6
about: Zond-6 (1968-101A), a crewed vehicle (L-1), launched 1968 Nov 10. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DSO).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1968 Nov 11), held fixed

events.why: GCAT gives the launch without an hour
